neighbours.label: a plural noun after 'all' (all samples, all values), or the verb right after it; other quantifiers and determiners do not do this
fire: In this study all samples were stored at room temperature.
Note that all prices are shown before tax.
Afterwards all calculations were repeated by a second author.
According to the manual, all dimensions are in millimetres.
In this report all figures are preliminary.
After the upgrade all servers were running again.
In the trials all experiments used the same strain of mice.
In the appendix, all values are rounded to one decimal.
quiet: In this study few samples were stored at room temperature.
Note that our prices are shown before tax.
Afterwards most calculations were repeated by a second author.
According to the manual, the dimensions are in millimetres.
In this report some figures are preliminary.
After the upgrade two servers were running again.
In the trials both experiments used the same strain of mice.
In the appendix, these values are rounded to one decimal.
